summary: Frontend-only regression + new features testing (Personas rewrite, Blog list, BlogPost pages). All acceptance criteria pass. No runtime errors on the pages tested.
critical_code_review_comments: BlogPost useEffect cleanup: if the page is navigated to a slug that does not exist, the useEffect early-returns without setting title/meta, which is correct. Title restoration works on unmount (verified: navigating from /blog/<slug> back to / restores 'Enlace Fintech · Tu broker fintech de confianza').

Blog related list reuses Blog component and, since it does not receive an id, it renders another element with data-testid='blog-section' and 'blog-post-0..2' on the article page — same testids as the /blog listing. This currently works but may confuse future tests that expect unique ids per section.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New /personas content and Blog + BlogPost pages verified against the acceptance list. Notable: Overline component applies CSS text-transform:uppercase, and blog-article-category renders uppercased; when writing string matchers, use case-insensitive or match against the raw content in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js (BLOG.posts). The related-articles section on a BlogPost reuses the Blog component so its cards share the blog-post-N testids with the /blog listing.
